note: One row per state and DC. Verdicts follow the rules in STATE_INJURY_CRASH_SOURCES_2026-11-01.md. 'unknown' means not verified, never absent. Terms are quoted from the publisher's own pages or ArcGIS item metadata.

states.terms: "These data are not to be shared with the public pursuant to Alabama Law and 23 U.S.C. 148(h)(4) and 409."
states.access: Email request and signed confidentiality agreement
states.reason: ALDOT releases no crash-level data to the public, and approved access forbids disclosure.
